mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are at 50 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a Waning Gibbous moon phase. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city wants to remind you about waste services and winter rules. Pellitteri Waste Systems provides weekly refuse and biweekly recycling collection, and remember that alternate-side winter parking regulations begin on November 20 through April 1.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can check out the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddys Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we have yoga on November 2 and various trivia nights starting November 4.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were caught riding prohibited eMotos, resulting in their parents being cited for the incident.
You can grab the delicious Mint Explosion flavor of the day when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
